picks.name: Niagara
picks.source_note: Príncipe already seeded. An earlier lead on the trio's "Pais & Filhos" album turned out to be from 2020 and was dropped at the time; this is a genuinely new, dated album.
picks.bio: "Catedral Gótica" (October 30, 2026, Príncipe, cat. P068) is an album from Lisbon trio Niagara (Sara Eckerson, António and Alberto Arruda), who've been a core act on the label since the 2010s, known for a slowed-down, post-punk-inflected take on house and techno set apart from the label's faster kuduro/batida side.
picks.why_listen: Lo-fi, punk-leaning house with a loose, hypnotic pulse -- a good off-kilter change of texture in a set built on Príncipe's faster club styles.

picks.name: UNIIQU3
picks.source_note: Local Action already seeded. New artist discovery -- her debut album for the label.
picks.bio: "Mass Appeal" (November 6, 2026, Local Action) is the debut album from Newark Jersey club producer UNIIQU3, a ten-track record with guest turns from Cakes Da Killa, Spank Rock, Leonce, Samurai Breaks, and BÉBE YANA, following over a decade championing the genre.
picks.why_listen: High-energy, bounce-heavy Jersey club with strong vocal features throughout -- built for a peak, dancefloor-driving stretch of a set.
